☕️ GM! Here are the top events in #Crypto from the past 24 hours

📊Market Updates

🔸Ethereum hits new all-time high above $4,878, up 40% YTD, fueled by ETF inflows, treasuries, and Powell’s rate cut hints.

🔸SharpLink Gaming approves $1.5B stock buyback to strengthen its $3.14B Ether treasury, aiming to boost ETH-per-share value.

🔸Crypto Fear & Greed Index jumps to 60 (Greed) as BTC and ETH rally on Powell’s dovish speech hinting at a September Fed rate cut.

🌟Highlights

🔸Philippines proposes Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Act to buy 2,000 BTC annually, building a 10,000 BTC reserve held for 20 years.

🔸US GENIUS Act spurs EU to accelerate digital euro plans, with ECB exploring Ethereum or Solana to counter USD stablecoin dominance.

🔸VanEck files for JitoSOL ETF, the first spot Solana fund backed by a liquid staking token, amid SEC clarity on staking rules.

🔸Japan’s SBI partners with Circle, Ripple, and Startale to launch stablecoin ventures and a tokenized asset trading platform.

🔸Dormant BTC whale resurfaces after 7 years, selling holdings to buy 62,914 ETH ($270M) and opening a $580M ETH derivatives long.

🔸Grayscale, Bitwise, and others file amended spot XRP ETF proposals, seen as a positive sign of progress with SEC feedback.

🔸First buyer of Kanye West’s YZY token was trader “Naseem” who once made $100M on TRUMP memecoin. He’s already pulled $1M from YZY.

🚦 TRAFFIC ADVISORY – HYDERABAD MARATHON 2025 🏃‍♂️🏃‍♀️

📅 Sunday, 24th August 2025
🕔 5:00 AM – 11:30 AM

The 14th Hyderabad Marathon will be held across major city roads. Traffic restrictions & diversions will be in place in Cyberabad limits.

📍 Event Routes
* 42K / 21K → People’s Plaza, Necklace Road
* 10K Run → Hitex Grounds, Madhapur
* Culmination → Gachibowli Stadium

⚠️ Key Restrictions
* 🚫 Kothaguda ↔ Cyber Towers (till 7:15 AM)
* 🚫 Indiranagar ↔ HCU Gate No.2 (till 11:30 AM)
* 🚫 Lemon Tree ↔ Cyber Towers (till 8:00 AM)
* 🚫 IKEA ↔ Cyber Towers (till 8:00 AM)
* 🚫 Road No.45 Flyover & Cable Bridge (till 8:30 AM)

✅ Alternate Routes
Use ORR, Rolling Hills, IKEA Flyover, Biodiversity Flyovers, Madhapur Main Road & other suggested diversions.

🙏 Public Appeal
Commuters are advised to avoid restricted stretches & plan travel accordingly. Kindly cooperate with Cyberabad Traffic Police.

📢 Issued in Public Interest by
Joint Commissioner of Police, Traffic – Cyberabad

#HyderabadMarathon #TrafficAdvisory #CyberabadTrafficPolice
